items.title: Microsoft Releases Out-of-Band Security Updates for Brotli and .NET tarballs Vulnerability
items.description:
Microsoft has released out-of-band security updates for .NET to fix a Brotli buffer overflow and unsafe ownership settings in Linux distribution archives. Published on October 25, 2026, the release covers .NET 8, .NET 9, .NET 10, and .NET 11 Release Candidate 3. Microsoft urges users to update as soon as possible. The official Microsoft announcement […]
